name: Raloxifene
description: A selective estrogen receptor modulator approved for osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and for breast-cancer risk reduction. Agonist at bone, antagonist at breast and endometrium.

systems.note: Bone mineral density preservation is the labelled indication.
Estrogen receptor modulation is the intended pharmacology.
Boxed warning for venous thromboembolism and fatal stroke.

monitors.why: Bone density is the labelled efficacy endpoint.
